"VocalSet: A Singing Voice Dataset". 19th International Society for Music Information Retrieval Conference (ISMIR), Paris, France, 2018. notes: Production use limited to scales/arpeggios/long_tones; excerpts excluded by project policy. Pinned: Zenodo record 1203819 v1.1, VocalSet11.zip (md5 verified). Citation: Research Lead confirmed from the ISMIR 2018 paper (2026-10-08). Split frozen for Data Factory v0 (test: 5 publisher singers; val: female9, male11; train: 13). Publisher singer split found in the archive (test_singers_technique.txt) and used for the test split.
